items.title: Myra Menville Interview, 1958-05-07, 09
items.q: And then there was a drummer by the name of Louis Cottrell, who is credited with being the first drummer who introduced the press role into the music.

ctx.x: A form of jazz music that you were playing? It was definitely not ragtime, I can tell you that. It was my interpretation of the difference between jazz and ragtime is, if you'll put it as simply as possible, is one is jerkier than the other one. And let's say the same difference that there is between jazz and swing, there is between ragtime and jazz. It was a smoother type of the same sort of music. But then our interest in the music became very deeper, much deeper personally, not with any idea of analysis. I…
Well, let's get back to the social aspect of it for the world in society. When you first started going to parties, they tend to have Negro bands or jazz bands or white or colored.
